roadmap.title: Easy exploration clear
roadmap.description: Learn the route, read all 29 files, use every key, create all herb recipes, and finish the one-off combat and boss tasks.

roadmap.title: Easy Leech Hunter rank A
roadmap.description: Use Extra Game to kill every enemy, collect all 100 charms, and save the Leech Hunter rewards into the Easy clear data.

roadmap.title: Easy no-recovery Rebecca clear
roadmap.description: Use the reward weapons, take no recovery items, and make Rebecca deal all damage to every eligible boss.

roadmap.title: Wesker Mode no-save clear
roadmap.description: Finish Wesker Mode without saving while earning 50 fully charged Death Stare kills.

roadmap.title: Normal setup clear
roadmap.description: Create a fresh Normal chain, upgrade the first character Handgun, and equip ordinary costumes.

roadmap.title: Normal Leech Hunter rank A
roadmap.description: Collect 100 charms on the Normal chain to add infinite ammunition and the Magnum Revolver.

roadmap.title: Normal S-rank and weapons
roadmap.description: Finish below 3:30:00, upgrade the other Handgun, then start Once Again and equip both timed weapons.

roadmap.title: Hard clear
roadmap.description: Start a fresh Hard game and complete the campaign with conservative combat.

roadmap.title: Single-color Leech cleanup
roadmap.description: Return to Easy Leech Hunter, collect all 50 green charms and no blue charms, then exit.

achievements.description: Complete the Ecliptic Express train chapter.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Ecliptic Express} train chapter.

guide.context: The train is the opening story area; the unlock occurs only after the brake sequence ends the chapter.

steps.text: Collect both brake-code inputs, activate the rear and engine controls, then survive the derailment.

achievements.description: Complete the Training Facility chapter and lower the observatory.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Training Facility} chapter and lower the observatory.

guide.context: The chapter ends after all three tablets are placed; optional basement and side-room tasks should be finished before lowering the observatory.

steps.text: Place the @item{Discipline}, @item{Obedience}, and @item{Unity Tablets} in the observatory mechanism and descend to the church area.

achievements.description: Complete the Laboratory chapter by boarding the cable car.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Laboratory} chapter by boarding the cable car.

guide.context: The Laboratory route separates Rebecca and Billy for much of the area, so transfer essential equipment before using the Hookshot route.

steps.text: Restore cable-car power, reunite the partners, take the @item{Magnum} inside the cable car, and ride to the Factory.

achievements.description: Complete the Factory chapter after surviving the first Proto Tyrant fight.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Factory} chapter after surviving the first @enemy{Proto Tyrant} fight.

guide.context: Rebecca handles this short section alone until the elevator restores access to the Treatment Plant.

steps.text: Restore the Factory elevator, drive off Proto Tyrant, and ride the elevator to the Treatment Plant.

achievements.description: Complete the Treatment Plant and defeat Queen Leech.
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Treatment Plant} and defeat @enemy{Queen Leech}.

guide.context: The final phase is won by protecting Rebecca while she opens four roof valves; Billy cannot complete those valves.

steps.text: Defeat Queen Leech through the first two combat phases, protect Rebecca while she opens all four valves, and finish the escape.

achievements.description: Finish the game with rank S.
achievements.summary: Finish a @mechanic{Normal or Hard} campaign in under @mechanic{3:30:00} to earn an S rank.

guide.context: Only completion time determines rank. Budget cutscenes and menu use as live time, and save and exit to the title screen before taking any long break.

steps.text: Use a Normal clear-data chain with Leech Hunter rewards, including the Magnum Revolver and infinite ammunition.
Skip cutscenes and optional rooms, save and exit to the title screen for long breaks, and finish before 3:30:00.

achievements.description: Finish the game on Hard difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the entire campaign on @mechanic{Hard} difficulty.

guide.context: Difficulty is fixed when a new save is created and cannot be changed through Once Again, so Hard requires a fresh New Game.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{New Game} and select Hard instead of loading another difficulty's 00 Clear save.
Avoid optional enemies, conserve Napalm and Magnum ammunition for bosses, and defeat Queen Leech.

achievements.description: Finish the game without combining herbs.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign without combining any @item{herbs}.

guide.context: The planned no-recovery run also satisfies this restriction and removes ambiguity about using single herbs.

steps.text: Do not pick up, mix, or use Green, Red, or Blue Herbs during the no-recovery clear.
Defeat Queen Leech and reach the results screen with the herb-combination record still at zero.

achievements.description: Finish the game without saving.
achievements.summary: Finish a complete campaign without saving at a typewriter.

guide.context: After one campaign clear unlocks Wesker Mode, its powerful weapons and abilities make it the safest one-session route; a regular campaign also counts.

steps.text: First clear the campaign to unlock @mechanic{Wesker Mode}, then start that mode and set aside enough time for an uninterrupted clear.
Never use an Ink Ribbon or confirm a typewriter save; complete the campaign in the same attempt.

achievements.description: Finish the game without using a First-Aid Spray.
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign without using any @item{First-Aid Spray}.

guide.context: This stacks with the stricter no-recovery achievement, which also forbids herbs and Green Chemicals.

steps.text: Leave every First-Aid Spray unused from the train through the final battle.
Reach the ending without a spray use recorded.

achievements.description: Finish the game without using a recovery item (including Green Chemicals).
achievements.summary: Finish a campaign without using herbs, @item{First-Aid Sprays}, or @item{Green Chemicals}.

guide.context: Leech Hunter infinite ammunition and the Magnum Revolver reduce exposure, but damage cannot be restored by any recovery item.

steps.text: Load the Easy 00 Clear data updated with a 100-charm Leech Hunter clear and choose Once Again.
Use no Green, Red, or Blue Herb, either alone or in any mixture, and use no First-Aid Spray or Green Chemical for the entire run.
Complete the campaign without restoring health.

achievements.description: Defeat Stinger in the train's second-floor dining car.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Stinger} in the train's second-floor dining car.

guide.context: Stinger is the mandatory first boss.

steps.text: Take the Hunting Gun upstairs, aim downward at Stinger's exposed head, and keep firing until it collapses.

achievements.description: Defeat Centurion in the Training Facility courtyard.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Centurion} in the Training Facility courtyard.

guide.context: Only Billy can fight while Rebecca is held, so this boss is excluded from the Rebecca-only boss challenge.

steps.text: Control Billy, use the Shotgun or Grenade Launcher on Centurion's exposed segments, and free Rebecca.

achievements.description: Defeat the Infected Bat inside the church.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Infected Bat} inside the church.

guide.context: Small bats enter as the boss takes damage; killing 16 before the large bat dies awards a separate achievement.

steps.text: Leave Billy on the chapel pressure plate, enter the church as Rebecca, and kill the Infected Bat.

achievements.description: Drive off Proto Tyrant during the first Factory encounter.
achievements.summary: Drive off @enemy{Proto Tyrant} during the first Factory encounter.

guide.context: Rebecca fights this encounter alone as part of the mandatory story route.

steps.text: Use the Factory elevator area for space, dodge past the boss's small-arm side, and deal enough damage to end the encounter.

achievements.description: Defeat Proto Tyrant during the second Treatment Plant encounter.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Proto Tyrant} during the second Treatment Plant encounter.

guide.context: Billy can be left outside the elevator room so Rebecca receives all boss damage credit.

steps.text: Leave Billy behind, send Rebecca down the Treatment Plant elevator, and kill Proto Tyrant.

achievements.description: Defeat Queen Leech and complete the final Treatment Plant battle.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Queen Leech} and complete the final Treatment Plant battle.

guide.context: The last phase ends when Rebecca opens four roof valves while Billy diverts the boss.

steps.text: Win the first two combat phases, then keep Queen Leech focused on Billy until Rebecca opens all four valves.

achievements.description: Use Rebecca to deal all damage to every eligible boss except Centurion.
achievements.summary: Use @npc{Rebecca} to deal all damage to every eligible boss except @enemy{Centurion}.

guide.context: Centurion and the last valve-opening Queen Leech phase are excluded; Billy should be left behind or set to Solo/Idle with no weapon at the four shared fights.

steps.text: On the train, send Billy through the roof so Rebecca remains free to kill Stinger.
Leave Billy on the church pressure plate and kill Infected Bat as Rebecca.
Fight both Proto Tyrant encounters as Rebecca; the first is forced, and Billy should remain outside the second.
Unequip Billy before the first Queen Leech battle and have Rebecca deal every point of damage through the first two phases.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with a critical-hit headshot.
achievements.summary: Make a critical shot destroy an enemy’s head.

guide.context: Handguns can trigger random critical hits, while an upward Shotgun blast at point-blank range is more dependable.

steps.text: Let a zombie approach, aim the Shotgun upward, and fire into its head until the head bursts on the killing shot.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy by burning them.
achievements.summary: Kill any enemy with fire damage from a @item{Molotov Cocktail} or Napalm Grenade.

guide.context: Mimicry Marcus is especially vulnerable to fire and can share this unlock with How ’Bout a Light, Bud?.

steps.text: Throw a Molotov Cocktail at a zombie or Mimicry Marcus and make the fire damage deliver the final blow.

achievements.description: Defeat a zombie by stomping on them.
achievements.summary: Let a crawling @enemy{zombie} grab a character, then break free and stomp its head.

guide.context: A crawling zombie in the Laboratory morgue-like room provides a consistent setup.

steps.text: Approach a living crawling zombie, allow the leg grab, and rapidly press the movement inputs until the character stomps it dead.

achievements.description: Create a Molotov Cocktail.
achievements.summary: Combine one @item{Gas Tank} with one @item{Empty Bottle} to create a Molotov Cocktail.

guide.context: The first pair appears after Stinger: gas is in the dog storage room and a bottle is inside the kitchen refrigerator.

steps.text: After opening the train kitchen hatch, take the Gas Tank from the dog storage room and the Empty Bottle from the opened refrigerator.
Combine the Gas Tank and Empty Bottle in the inventory.

achievements.description: Change into a costume.
achievements.summary: Use a character’s @item{Suitcase} to change Rebecca or Billy into any alternate costume.

guide.context: The Suitcase replaces Rebecca's Mixing Set or Billy's Lighter through the Switch command; no wardrobe room is required.

steps.text: Open the inventory, select Rebecca's Mixing Set or Billy's Lighter, and choose @mechanic{Switch}.
Open the Suitcase and select any available costume.

achievements.displayName: Here I Come to Save the Day
achievements.description: Attack an enemy to save your partner who is grappling with that enemy.
achievements.summary: Attack an enemy while that enemy is grappling the other partner.

guide.context: The rescue must be performed by the free partner before the grapple victim breaks loose or dies.

steps.text: Let a zombie grab Rebecca while Billy stands nearby with a loaded weapon.
Switch to Billy and shoot the grappling zombie before Rebecca escapes.

achievements.description: Defeat an enemy with a knife.
achievements.summary: Kill any enemy with a @item{Knife}.

guide.context: The Stinger fight or the first Mimicry Marcus knife challenge can supply this naturally.

steps.text: Equip a Knife and keep striking one enemy until knife damage deals the killing blow.

achievements.description: Destroy a zombie's legs.
achievements.summary: Use a downward @item{Shotgun} blast to destroy a zombie’s legs.

guide.context: The zombie need not die from the shot; visible leg destruction triggers the award.

steps.text: Let a standing zombie approach, aim downward with the Shotgun, and fire into both legs at close range.

achievements.description: Shoot a jumping Hunter or Eliminator out of the air.
achievements.summary: Shoot a jumping @enemy{Hunter} or @enemy{Eliminator} out of the air.

guide.context: The Training Facility basement rescue room has several Eliminators and a doorway that provides repeatable spacing.

steps.text: Enter the Eliminator room beyond the boiler-room statues and wait near the doorway with the Shotgun aimed upward.
Fire while an Eliminator is airborne during its leap; the enemy only needs to be knocked down, not killed.

achievements.description: Break free from a Cerberus bite or tackle grapple.
achievements.summary: Break free from a @enemy{Cerberus} bite or tackle grapple.

guide.context: The earliest reliable dogs appear in the train storage section after the kitchen hatch.

steps.text: Let a Cerberus tackle and pin the character, then rapidly press movement inputs until the dog is thrown away.

achievements.description: Open the code 385 Duralumin Case and combine its Handgun Parts with either starting Handgun.
achievements.summary: Open the code @mechanic{385} Duralumin Case and combine its Handgun Parts with either starting Handgun.

guide.context: Only one Handgun can be customized per playthrough; all-weapons progress therefore needs the other character's Custom Handgun on a linked replay.

steps.text: After Billy rescues Rebecca in the Training Facility basement, take the Locker Key from the first right-hand room in the spider corridor.
Use the Locker Key on the battle-room locker, open the Duralumin Case with 385, and take the Handgun Parts.
Combine the parts with Rebecca's or Billy's Handgun and remember which one was upgraded.

achievements.description: Have Rebecca collect and consume a Green Chemical.
achievements.summary: Have @npc{Rebecca} collect and consume a @item{Green Chemical}.

guide.context: Green Chemical cures poison and counts as recovery, so do this outside the no-recovery playthrough.

steps.text: In the Training Facility, insert both Microfilms and use the MO Disk to solve the conference-room seating puzzle. Go through the newly unlocked knight door, follow the corridor to its far room, and kill the two zombies beside the green chemical tank.
Control Rebecca, interact with the green tank, choose Add to Mixing Set, then consume the stored Green Chemical.

achievements.description: Deal the final damage to Mimicry Marcus with fire from a Molotov Cocktail or Napalm round.
achievements.summary: Deal the final damage to @enemy{Mimicry Marcus} with fire from a Molotov Cocktail or Napalm round.

guide.context: Fire is its intended weakness; the killing blow, not merely some damage, must come from the approved fire weapon.

steps.text: Weaken a Mimicry Marcus if needed, then finish it with a thrown Molotov Cocktail or a Napalm round.

achievements.description: Obtain all keys and use them all.
achievements.summary: Obtain and fully use all @item{13 keys and keycards}, including the optional @item{Locker Key}.

guide.context: Use each key on every matching lock until the Discard prompt appears. The Locker Key is the only optional entry and must open the basement battle-room locker.

steps.text: Take the Dining Car Key from the train corpse and unlock the Dining Car door.
After Billy falls through the train roof, send the Conductor’s Office Key through the service lift to Rebecca and unlock the Conductor’s Office.
Fit the Gold and Silver Rings into the Duralumin Briefcase, take the Blue Keycard, and use it on the train card-reader door.
Take the Magnetic Keycard before the runaway-train sequence and use it at the rear brake control.
After Centurion, take the Facility Key marked with fire and open every red-marked Training Facility door until it can be discarded.
In the B3 spider corridor, enter the first right-hand waterfall room, kill both Plague Crawlers, take the Locker Key from the wooden box, and use it on the battle-room locker.
Take the Facility Key marked with water from the basement battle cage and open every blue-marked Training Facility door until it can be discarded.
Use the Sterilizing Agent to clear the Laboratory gas chamber, take the Breeding Room Key, and unlock the Breeding Room.
Take the Factory Key from the Factory monitor room and insert it into the small-lift control.
After meeting Enrico, take the Elevator Key and use it on the Factory elevator panel.
Raise the Treatment Plant lift with the Hi-Power Battery, take the Keycard, and use it on the B7 card-reader door.
After the first Queen Leech fight, take the left and right Shaft Keys and insert both into the final shaft door.

achievements.description: Defeat the first Mimicry Marcus using only Knives.
achievements.summary: Defeat the first @enemy{Mimicry Marcus} using only Knives.

guide.context: Every point of damage during this first bathroom encounter must come from a Knife; both partners may attack when both are equipped with Knives.

steps.text: Keep Billy’s starting Knife and collect the second Knife from the train roof-drop room, then equip Rebecca and Billy with one Knife each.
In the first-floor Training Facility west bathroom, let either or both partners slash Mimicry Marcus until it dies without using firearms, Molotov Cocktails, or any other damage source.

achievements.description: Combine every type of herb with each other.
achievements.summary: Create all @item{six herb mixtures} during one campaign.

guide.context: During the first Training Facility exploration, leave at least 10 Green Herbs, 2 Red Herbs, and 3 Blue Herbs in the main hall. After clearing the upper and lower floors and opening the basement, return to this stockpile; Rebecca must create each recipe separately.

collectibles.name: Green + Green
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Green from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

collectibles.name: Green + Red
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Red from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

collectibles.name: Green + Blue
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Blue from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

collectibles.name: Green + Green + Green
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Green, Green from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

collectibles.name: Green + Green + Blue
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Green, Blue from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

collectibles.name: Green + Red + Blue
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility main hall stockpile, after the basement opens}
collectibles.method: Use Rebecca to combine Green, Red, Blue from the staged stockpile as this exact standalone recipe.

achievements.description: Obtain all weapons.
achievements.summary: Collect and equip every weapon variation, including both Custom Handguns and both timed rewards, on one linked save chain.

guide.context: Keep one Normal 00 Clear chain: upgrade Rebecca’s Handgun on the setup clear and save its 00 Clear data; choose Once Again, upgrade Billy’s Handgun during the S-rank clear, and save the new 00 Clear data; then choose Once Again again to equip the Sub-Machinegun and Rocket Launcher. Weapon registration persists through that chain, and the Grenade Launcher must also be equipped with Acid, Grenade, and Napalm rounds in turn.

collectibles.name: Billy’s Knife
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Second Knife
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Rebecca’s Handgun
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Rebecca’s Custom Handgun
collectibles.method: Take the Locker Key from the wooden box in the B3 waterfall room, open the battle-room locker, enter 385 on the Duralumin Case, combine its Handgun Parts with Rebecca’s Handgun, equip the result, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Billy’s Handgun
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Billy’s Custom Handgun
collectibles.location: @loc{Training Facility B3 battle-room locker on the linked replay}
collectibles.method: On the second campaign of the linked 00 Clear chain, repeat the Locker Key, battle-room locker, Duralumin Case code 385, and Handgun Parts sequence with Billy’s Handgun; equip the result and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Hunting Gun
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Shotgun
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Grenade Launcher with all ammo
collectibles.method: Collect and equip the launcher, then load Acid, Grenade, and Napalm rounds one type at a time.

collectibles.name: Molotov Cocktail
collectibles.location: @loc{Combine a Gas Tank and Empty Bottle}
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Magnum
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Magnum Revolver
collectibles.location: @loc{Earn Leech Hunter rank B or A; collect it in Train Room 202}
collectibles.method: Collect the weapon, equip it, and close the inventory.

collectibles.name: Sub-Machinegun
collectibles.location: @loc{Finish Normal or Hard in 4:59:59 or less; equip it from Billy’s inventory on Once Again}
collectibles.method: After saving the S-rank result as 00 Clear data, load that data, choose Once Again, and equip this timed reward.

collectibles.name: Rocket Launcher
collectibles.location: @loc{Finish Normal or Hard in 3:29:59 or less; equip it from Rebecca’s inventory on Once Again}
collectibles.method: After saving the S-rank result as 00 Clear data, load that data, choose Once Again, and equip this timed reward.

achievements.description: Kill 16 Small Bats during the church’s Infected Bat fight before killing the boss.
achievements.summary: Kill @enemy{16 Small Bats} during the church’s Infected Bat fight before killing the boss.

guide.context: Small Bats spawn as the large bat takes damage; killing Infected Bat too quickly ends the only farming opportunity.

steps.text: Damage Infected Bat enough to make Small Bats enter the church, then stop attacking the boss.
Kill 16 Small Bats with accurate Handgun or Shotgun fire before finishing Infected Bat.

achievements.description: After a campaign clear unlocks Wesker Mode, finish that mode and equip Rebecca’s Team Wesker costume in a later campaign.
achievements.summary: After a campaign clear unlocks @mechanic{Wesker Mode}, finish that mode and equip Rebecca’s @item{Team Wesker costume} in a later campaign.

guide.context: The costume is awarded globally only after the Wesker Mode ending; it is then selected through Rebecca’s Suitcase.

steps.text: Complete one regular campaign to unlock Wesker Mode.
Finish Wesker Mode and return to the main menu.
Start another campaign, select Rebecca’s Mixing Set, choose Switch, open the Suitcase, and select Team Wesker.

achievements.description: Use Rebecca to play the Training Facility piano.
achievements.summary: Use @npc{Rebecca} to play the Training Facility piano.

guide.context: The piano remains usable after Billy solves the mandatory melody, so this can be cleaned up before leaving the facility.

steps.text: Switch to Rebecca in the piano room and interact with the piano until she attempts the melody.

achievements.displayName: I'm a Medic, Not a Bodybuilder
achievements.description: Try to push something heavy with Rebecca.
achievements.summary: Make @npc{Rebecca} attempt to push a heavy movable object and fail.

guide.context: Rebecca lacks Billy’s pushing strength; the small library opened by the candle puzzle contains an early suitable object.

steps.text: In the Training Facility small library, control Rebecca and push against the movable bookcase until her failed-effort animation plays.

achievements.description: Allow the church Infected Bat to grab Rebecca and carry her into the air.
achievements.summary: Allow the church @enemy{Infected Bat} to grab Rebecca and carry her into the air.

guide.context: The grab is a distinct swooping attack; keep enough health to survive the subsequent drop.

steps.text: During the Infected Bat fight, stand in open space and avoid shooting during a low swoop until the boss lifts Rebecca.

achievements.description: Start Leech Hunter from the Extra Game option after a campaign clear.
achievements.summary: Start @mechanic{Leech Hunter} from the @mechanic{Extra Game} option after a campaign clear.

guide.context: Leech Hunter inherits the difficulty of the selected 00 Clear save and cannot be saved mid-run.

steps.text: Load a 00 Clear save, choose Extra Game, and enter the Training Facility.

achievements.description: Exit Leech Hunter carrying all 100 Leech Charms to earn rank A.
achievements.summary: Exit @mechanic{Leech Hunter} carrying all @item{100 Leech Charms} to earn rank A.

guide.context: There are 50 green charms only Rebecca can hold and 50 blue charms only Billy can hold; charms cannot be dropped.

steps.text: Kill the initial enemies before loading inventories with charms.
Gather all 50 green charms as Rebecca and all 50 blue charms as Billy.
Use the Training Facility main-hall front door while both characters collectively hold 100 charms.

achievements.description: Exit Leech Hunter with at least one Leech Charm to receive rank E or better.
achievements.summary: Exit @mechanic{Leech Hunter} with at least one Leech Charm to receive rank E or better.

guide.context: This stacks automatically with any higher rank, including the planned 100-charm rank-A clear.

steps.text: Collect at least one green or blue Leech Charm and leave through the Training Facility main-hall front door.

achievements.description: Exit Leech Hunter with all 50 charms of one color and zero charms of the other color.
achievements.summary: Exit @mechanic{Leech Hunter} with all @item{50 charms of one color} and zero charms of the other color.

guide.context: Rebecca alone collects green charms and Billy alone collects blue charms; picking up even one opposite-color charm voids this run.

steps.text: Load the Easy clear data. Have Rebecca collect all 50 green charms while Billy collects zero blue charms and remains free to fight.
Pick up every green charm as Rebecca and do not let Billy pick up any blue charm.
Leave through the main-hall front door with Rebecca holding 50 green charms and Billy holding zero blue charms.

achievements.description: Kill every enemy in Leech Hunter, including the enemies that respawn after 90 charms are collected.
achievements.summary: Kill every enemy in @mechanic{Leech Hunter}, including the enemies that respawn after 90 charms are collected.

guide.context: The award appears on the final kill, not at the exit. Hidden crawling zombies—including one beneath the deer-head room table—are common misses.

steps.text: Before collecting charms, clear every accessible room of enemies while Billy still has weapon space.
Collect 90 charms to trigger the replacement wave, then sweep every room again.
Move the deer-head room table, check floors for crawling zombies, and continue until the achievement appears on the last kill.

achievements.description: After a campaign clear unlocks Wesker Mode, kill 50 enemies there with fully charged Death Stare blasts.
achievements.summary: After a campaign clear unlocks @mechanic{Wesker Mode}, kill @mechanic{50 enemies} there with fully charged Death Stare blasts.

guide.context: Only fully charged releases count; the red area blast kills most ordinary enemies and provides more than 50 targets across a full campaign.

steps.text: Complete one regular campaign to unlock Wesker Mode, then start that mode from the Extras menu.
Aim Death Stare at a safe group of zombies and hold the attack input for roughly three seconds until full charge.
Release the charged red blast to kill enemies, and repeat until the achievement appears after the 50th credited kill.
